from pathlib import Path
program_dir=Path('/home/ubuntu/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/runs/adhoc-primeagentlearner-1792545741/attempts/24c6b32aa5ef47bea0ad877ddcf721da/system/state/workspace/programs')
program_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
source='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    counts = {}
    for row in grid:
        for value in row:
            if value != 0:
                counts[value] = counts.get(value, 0) + 1
    marker = min(counts, key=counts.get)
    points = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] == marker]
    r0 = min(r for r, c in points)
    c0 = min(c for r, c in points)
    shape = [(r-r0, c-c0) for r, c in points]
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            if all(r+dr < h and c+dc < w and grid[r+dr][c+dc] == 0 for dr, dc in shape):
                for dr, dc in shape:
                    out[r+dr][c+dc] = marker
    return out
'''
